REACHABLE.observed_result: A current parent construction program was present on main before child execution; ordinary governance exposed two dependency-valid, authority-bounded, path-disjoint sibling packages together; both executed; a fresh contradiction reopened only the affected sibling; bounded repair restored the program to green.

RECOVERABLE.reason: The run demonstrated bounded repair after a child contradiction, but did not exercise rollback/recovery of the construction-program state itself.

CONSUMER_ACCEPTED.reason: Construction governance reachability is not Personal Production or consumer acceptance.

VALUE_EVIDENCED.reason: No measured real-work throughput, quality, or user-value consequence has yet been recorded.

anti_collapse_rule: This first real program proves governance reachability. It does not prove recoverability, Personal Production acceptance, consumer acceptance, or value.
